description: VAERS report counts by symptom (MedDRA preferred term), optionally filtered to one vaccine and/or year range. Pass `symptom` as a substring (e.g. "headache", "anaphyla", "myocarditis") to count how often it was reported; omit it to see the most-reported symptoms overall (optionally within one vaccine). Answers "how many VAERS reports mention myocarditis after the COVID-19 vaccine", "most commonly reported symptoms for the flu vaccine in 2022". Counts are MENTIONS — a report naming several symptoms and/or several vaccines contributes to each combination, so this is not a count of unique reports. IMPORTANT: a symptom being reported alongside a vaccine is NOT evidence the vaccine caused it — VAERS accepts any report from anyone, unverified. Every response carries the CDC/FDA disclaimer and `is_causal: false`. This never returns a single report's free text.

symptom.description: Symptom substring (MedDRA preferred term), e.g. "headache", "anaphyla", "myocarditis". Omit to see the top symptoms.

vaccine.description: VAERS vax_type code to narrow to one vaccine, e.g. "COVID19". Optional.

year_from.description: Earliest report-received year to include (data covers 1990-2026).

name: vaers_events_by_symptom
title: Vaers Events By Symptom
